sign: Upper terrace: Rest Pool and the Cinder hollow

lines: Someone stashed two Dash Brews under this rock!
Nothing under the rock now.
Keeper: Rest by the pool a while.
night_lines: Keeper: Late visitor? The pool glows at night. Rest, the stars won't mind.

lines: Trader: Supplies for the road! Your satchel holds as much as you like.

lines: Sparkseer: Every Spirling carries a spark of the Rift. Let me look at yours.
Sparkseer: A Spark Charm brightens a spark that runs faint. The crystal stall sells them.
Crystal seller: Echo Crystals keep an art's echo. Teach it as often as you like!
Crystal seller: And things for Spirlings to hold, brews, pearls...

lines: Elder: The Cinder hollow is up the stairs. Its Warden, Orrin, hasn't said a word in weeks.
Elder: A Warden whose bond breaks becomes part of the Hush. Wake him, and he can help you mend the tear.
Elder: Orrin laughed today. First time since the storm.
Elder: Veydal owes you, young cartographer.
Elder: He says he'll come down to the village for the ember feast. We haven't seen him here in years.
Pell: Orrin bakes bread now. It's so hard Marek splits it with his chisel and still calls it the best stone of the week.

suri: Suri: I thought the Hush would last forever. Now I'm learning to make Echo Crystals.
Suri: My Kindlop runs warm, not hot. That's the difference, I think.

lines: Driver Sela: Valley Coach, Thornridge stop. The road down is gentler than the stairs.
Shepherd Ula: I count my flock twice. Ivo I don't count at all. He's asleep somewhere.
Shepherd Ula: My flock sleeps through the night again. No more ash on the wind.
Stonecutter Marek: Ivo guards the night like a stone guards the road. Lying there, getting walked over.
Stonecutter Marek: The stone rings clean again. The Rift made it sound cracked.
Herbalist Rue: I have a herb for every pain. For Marek's jokes, nothing helps.
Herbalist Rue: The herbs grow sweet again. Bitter only where they should be.
Night Watch Ivo: I keep watch so the village can sleep. They keep laughing so I can't.
Night Watch Ivo: Quiet nights since the Rift closed. I almost miss the trouble. Almost.
Apprentice Kip: I learn smithing in Copperfold every evening. Days, I sweep the elder's porch.
Apprentice Kip: The forge fire burns blue in Copperfold now. Smith Holt says that's luck.
An old cartographer's stone. A compass rose is cut into it, worn almost smooth.
Night Watch Ivo: I was NOT asleep! Take these coins and tell nobody.
